records.title: Program Khas Biasiswa Selangor Bitara
records.description:
Program Khas Biasiswa Selangor Bitara is a full scholarship programme offered by the Selangor State
Government through TKWBNS.
It supports outstanding candidates pursuing Bachelor's Degree, Master's and PhD studies at 50 leading
universities worldwide, based on the 2026 Times Higher Education or QS World University Rankings by
Subject.
The programme prioritises fields that contribute to Selangor's Smart State development.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Applicant and both parents must be Malaysian citizens.
Applicant or at least one parent must be born in Selangor, or applicant must have resided in
Selangor for more than 10 years.
Open to public servants and members of the public.
Must not exceed 40 years old in the year studies begin.
Minimum CGPA 3.75 or equivalent in the relevant previous qualification.
Must have an offer from an eligible top 50 university in the chosen subject ranking.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Minimum English proficiency: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 550 or MUET Band 3.0.
Must not receive another education sponsorship.
Research applicants must submit an approved research proposal contributing to Selangor's
development.
Public servants must have at least five years of service in the Selangor State Government
administration.
Private-sector applicants must have at least five years of employment in Selangor.
Approved Fields
Governance
Energy and Utilities
Water Management
Healthcare
Education
Technology
Environment
Manufacturing
Business
Transport and Mobility
Islamic Affairs
Human and Social Development
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/bitara

records.title: Penang Future Foundation (PFF) Scholarship
records.description:
Penang Future Foundation is a flagship scholarship programme initiated by the Penang State
Government to develop talented Malaysian graduates and strengthen Penang's talent ecosystem.
The programme supports undergraduate students pursuing selected high-demand academic disciplines
at Malaysian public and private universities.
Successful scholars must fulfil a service bond by working in Penang after graduation. The bond duration
depends on the total sponsorship received.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be 25 years old or younger.
Must pursue a full-time first Bachelor's Degree.
Must enrol in a programme fully accredited by MQA.
Must have completed STPM, Foundation, Matriculation, Diploma, UEC or equivalent qualifications.
Penang Scholar applicants require a minimum CGPA of 3.67.
Mutiara Scholar applicants require a CGPA between 3.00 and 3.66.
Penang Scholar household income must not exceed RM15,000 monthly.
Mutiara Scholar household income must not exceed RM5,000 monthly.
Eligible disciplines include Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), Accountancy
and Finance.
Medicine is excluded.
Must maintain the required academic performance throughout sponsorship.
Funding Details
Item Penang Scholar Mutiara Scholar
Tuition fees Up to RM100,000 Up to RM60,000
Monthly allowance RM800 RM500
Study duration Normal degree duration Normal degree duration
Employment bond Yes Yes
Official Source: https://penangfuturefoundation.my/scholarship-eligibility/

records.title: Sarawak Free Tertiary Education Scheme (FTES)
records.description:
The Sarawak Free Tertiary Education Scheme (FTES) is a state government initiative introduced in
February 2026 to make higher education more accessible to Sarawakian students.
The scheme covers selected Bachelor's Degree programmes at four designated state-owned higher
education institutions.
The programme focuses on developing skilled graduates in areas such as engineering, science,
technology, medicine, law, accounting and finance.
Eligible students do not need to submit a separate scholarship application. Universities forward the
details of eligible students to the state government for sponsorship processing.
Participating Institutions
Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS).
Swinburne University of Technology Sarawak Campus.
Curtin University Malaysia.
University of Technology Sarawak (UTS).
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Sarawakian.
Must receive admission to one of the four participating institutions.
Must pursue an eligible Bachelor's Degree programme.
Must fulfil the institution's admission requirements.
Must meet the FTES sponsorship conditions.
Programme must be included in the approved list of 64 courses.
Must comply with the university's academic progression requirements.
.
Funding Details
Item Amount
Tuition fees 100%
Living assistance Up to RM15,000/year
Funding duration Approved degree duration
Eligible programmes 64 selected programmes
Separate scholarship application Not required

records.title: Biasiswa Yayasan Sarawak Tun Taib (BYSTT)
records.description:
Biasiswa Yayasan Sarawak Tun Taib is one of the major education sponsorship programmes offered by
Yayasan Sarawak.
The programme supports talented Sarawakian students pursuing higher education in selected academic
disciplines.
Priority is given to STEM and other strategic fields, including Aerospace Engineering, Semiconductor
Technology, Information Technology, Medicine and Health, Life Sciences, Food Technology, Psychology,
Accounting, Finance and Law.
For first Bachelor's Degrees, sponsorship applications are for Malaysian institutions only. Postgraduate
sponsorship applications may cover institutions in Malaysia or overseas.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen and anak jati Sarawak.
At least one parent must be Sarawakian by birth.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must have received an offer letter from a recognised higher education institution.
Must meet the academic requirements.
Undergraduate applicants must have at least CGPA 3.00 in STPM, Diploma, Matriculation or
Foundation, subject to the applicable entry requirements.
Postgraduate applicants must demonstrate excellent academic results, generally CGPA 3.00 or
above.
Must demonstrate leadership qualities and active participation in extracurricular and community
activities.
Must pass the scholarship selection and interview process.
Applicants currently studying at Certificate, Pre-Diploma, Diploma, Matriculation or Foundation
level are not eligible to apply under the advertised sponsorship category.

records.title: Tunku Abdul Rahman Scholarship (YTAR)
records.description:
The Tunku Abdul Rahman Scholarship is a nationwide scholarship programme supporting deserving
Malaysian students pursuing Bachelor's Degrees at recognised public and private universities.
The scholarship is particularly suitable for students who have overcome difficult circumstances and
demonstrate leadership potential.
Unlike tuition-only scholarships, YTAR provides comprehensive financial support throughout the
scholarship period.

Must enrol in an MQA-accredited Bachelor's Degree programme.
Open to prospective and current undergraduate students.
New undergraduate students must commence their degree by March 2027 under the stated
eligibility conditions.
Current degree students must have at least two years remaining, with graduation after September
2028.
Must demonstrate leadership potential.
Must demonstrate community involvement and commitment to social development.
Priority is given to students from disadvantaged backgrounds, rural communities and households
earning below RM5,250 monthly.

records.title: Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara Yayasan Pelajaran Johor (YPJ)
records.description:
Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara YPJ is an interest-free education loan offered to
eligible Johor students pursuing higher education at approved institutions in
Malaysia.
The loan is intended to help students cover education expenses throughout their
studies.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be born and reside in Johor.
Must have received an offer or be currently studying at an eligible institution.
Must pursue full-time studies.
Must have an MQA-accredited programme.
Must have at least one year of study remaining when applying.
Priority is given to students who do not have other sponsorships.
IPTA eligibility includes public universities, UiTM and polytechnics.
IPTS eligibility is limited to selected institutions, including KUYPJ, KKJ and
KUIJSI, depending on study level.
Must fulfil YPJ's other financing conditions.
How to Apply
1. Visit the MyEYPJ portal.
2. Register a new account or log in.
3. Select Pinjaman Pelajaran Dalam Negara.
4. Complete the application form.
5. Upload the required supporting documents.
6. Submit the application within the announced application period.

records.title: Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Negeri Sembilan (YNS)
records.description:
Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Negeri Sembilan is an education financing initiative by
the Negeri Sembilan State Government through Yayasan Negeri Sembilan.
The programme provides interest-free education loans to eligible Negeri Sembilan
students pursuing higher education at Malaysian public universities and other
approved institutions.
The scheme supports undergraduate and postgraduate students, subject to the
applicable study-level requirements.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must be born in Negeri Sembilan, OR have either parent born in Negeri
Sembilan, OR have resided in Negeri Sembilan for more than eight years.
Household income must not exceed RM8,400 per month under the current
published requirements.
Must have secured admission to an eligible public higher education institution
(IPTA/UA), polytechnic or approved YNS institution, depending on the study
category.
Must satisfy the full-time or part-time study conditions applicable to the
selected level.
For Diploma and Bachelor's Degree applicants, must apply for PTPTN first.
Applicants rejected by PTPTN must submit the official PTPTN rejection letter.
Must not receive another education loan or scholarship for the same studies
where prohibited.
Must fulfil YNS's academic and documentation requirements.
Additional Information
Diploma and Bachelor's Degree applicants are subject to PTPTN rejection
requirements.
Master's Degree and PhD applicants have separate application conditions.
PhD applications are indicated as open throughout the year.
The loan is paid according to semester arrangements, subject to submission of
examination results.
Repayment is generally requested six months after completion of studies,
according to YNS's FAQ.

records.title: Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi (PWPT) TAPEM
records.description:
Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi (PWPT) TAPEM is an education loan provided by
the Melaka State Government to assist eligible students from Melaka pursuing higher
education at recognised public and selected private higher education institutions.
The loan is intended to cover education expenses throughout the student's period of
study.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an Anak Negeri Melaka.
Must have received an offer to study at a public or private higher education
institution listed under TAPEM's approved sponsorship institutions.
Must pursue Diploma or Bachelor's Degree studies.
Must fulfil TAPEM's household income and financial assessment.
Must provide two guarantors upon accepting the loan.
Must sign the loan agreement.
Parents who are non-Malaysian citizens are not eligible under the published
conditions.
Definition of Anak Negeri Melaka
The eTAPEM application portal lists the following qualifying categories:
Applicant was born in Melaka; OR
Applicant's mother or father was born in Melaka; OR
Applicant has resided in Melaka for at least ten years.
The main TAPEM eligibility page also specifies residency and voter registration
conditions. Applicants should confirm which combination applies to their
circumstances with TAPEM before submitting.
Funding Amount
The financing depends on household income:
Household gross monthly income Financing
RM6,000 and below 100%
RM6,001–RM10,000 75%
Above RM10,000 50%
Examples of annual financing rates:
Institution / Programme Maximum annual
amount

Public university – Arts, Professional Studies, Islamic Studies
Degree
RM4,500
Public university – Diploma RM3,500
Polytechnic – Diploma RM3,500
Community College – Diploma RM3,500
Multimedia University – Technology / Engineering Degree RM6,500
Multimedia University – Management / Professional Degree RM5,500
Multimedia University – Diploma RM4,500
Akademi Laut Malaysia – Nautical Studies Diploma RM12,676.66
Amounts are based on TAPEM's published financing schedules and are subject to the
institution and programme eligibility.
Official Sources:
PWPT TAPEM – Eligibility and Application
TAPEM – IPTA Financing Rates
TAPEM – IPTS Financing Rates
Application Method
1. Visit the eTAPEM application portal.
2. Register an account.
3. Select Pinjaman Wang Pengajian Tinggi.
4. Complete the online application.
5. Print the completed application.
6. Attach the required supporting documents.
7. Obtain the necessary document verification.
8. Submit the application to TAPEM before the closing date.
Application Portal: https://tapemonline.melaka.gov.my/
Repayment Conditions
Borrowers must sign a loan agreement with two guarantors.
Repayment begins according to the repayment schedule issued after
completion of studies.
TAPEM issues the repayment schedule six months after the normal study
period ends.
Students who discontinue or are dismissed from their studies may be required
to repay the outstanding loan immediately.
Official Source: https://tapem.melaka.gov.my/pinjaman-wang-pengajian-tinggi

records.title: Peduli Siswa – Pinjaman Boleh Ubah Dalam Negara (PBUDN)
records.description:
Peduli Siswa PBUDN is an education financing programme provided by the Selangor
State Government to assist eligible Selangor students pursuing higher education in
Malaysia.
The financing is provided as a convertible education loan, whereby repayment
reductions are determined according to the student's final CGPA, subject to the
programme's conditions.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Applicant, mother or father must be born in Selangor; OR applicant must have
resided in Selangor for more than 10 years.
Applicant, mother and father must be Malaysian citizens.
Must be enrolled in full-time studies.
Must be pursuing Certificate, Diploma, Bachelor's Degree or eligible Medicine
studies.
Must be studying at:
Any recognised public university (IPTA) throughout Malaysia.
Recognised private universities (IPTS) in Selangor or Kuala Lumpur.
Must not be a final-year student or studying under an extension period.
Must not receive another scholarship, education loan or sponsorship for the
same studies.
Household income must not exceed RM20,000 per month.
Must fulfil the academic requirements for the respective study level.
Repayment Reduction
The loan may be reduced according to the final CGPA/PNGK achieved, provided the
student:
Completes studies within the approved period.
Does not breach the financing agreement.
Submits the official academic transcript and Senate certificate.
The exact repayment reduction percentage should be checked against the current
financing agreement.
Official Source: https://danapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/tkwbns/pembiayaan-pendidikan/pbudn
Application Portal: https://edanapendidikan.selangor.gov.my/

records.title: Yayasan Pahang Education Loan (Pinjaman Pendidikan Yayasan Pahang)
records.description:
The Yayasan Pahang Education Loan is a financing programme provided by the
Pahang State Government to assist eligible Pahang students pursuing higher
education at approved Malaysian educational institutions.
The programme supports selected academic and professional fields, as well as
students enrolled at designated institutions under Yayasan Pahang.
records.eligibility_criteria:
Must be a Malaysian citizen.
Must qualify as an Anak Negeri Pahang.
Must demonstrate good personal character.
Must be in good health.
Must have received an offer or be pursuing studies at an institution approved
by Yayasan Pahang.
Must meet the academic requirements for the relevant study level.
Must fulfil the programme-specific conditions.
Applicants whose parents are non-Malaysian citizens are not eligible.
Funding Amount by Study Level
Study Level / Institution Funding Amount
Master's / PhD – Full-time RM3,000 per year
Master's / PhD – Part-time Tuition fees up to RM10,000 throughout the
study period
Bachelor's Degree – 20 selected public
universities
RM3,000 per year
Polytechnic Diploma RM3,000 per year
SKM / DKM at YPAS Tuition fees and living allowance
Diploma / Degree at UCYP and KYP RM3,000 per year for eligible categories
Studies at UNIQSAAS Depends on study level and scheme
Skills Diploma at Pahang Skills Tuition fees and living allowance
Funding rates are based on Yayasan Pahang's published schedule. Not all study
levels are available at every institution.
Eligible Bachelor's Degree Fields at 20 Selected Public Universities
Pharmacy
Engineering and Technology
Islamic Economics and Finance
Accounting
Teaching English as a Second Language (TESL)
Agriculture and Halal Industry
Tourism and Heritage
Data Science
Artificial Intelligence
Automation and Robotics
E-Commerce
Digital Marketing
Additional Academic Requirements
Master's / PhD: Minimum CGPA of 3.00 or equivalent academic qualification,
subject to the applicable requirements.
Bachelor's Degree: Diploma CGPA of 3.20 or Foundation / Matriculation /
STPM CGPA of 3.00.
MUET: Minimum Band 2 for applicable Bachelor's Degree categories.
Polytechnic Diploma: Applicants must be in their second semester or above.
Repayment Conditions
The loan must be repaid.
Repayment generally begins six months after the sponsorship period ends.
Repayment deferment may be considered for borrowers who continue their
studies, subject to Yayasan Pahang's approval and conditions.
Application Method
1. Visit the official Yayasan Pahang website.
2. Check the latest education loan application announcement.
3. Register and apply through the SYSPIN system.
4. Complete the academic, family and guarantor information.
5. Submit the application before the closing date.
Official Source: Yayasan Pahang Education Loan – Official Information
Application Portal: SYSPIN – Online Application System
